# TextWiz

> TextWiz is a native macOS AI writing utility: copy text and press ⌘⇧Space, or use macOS Services to process a selection. On-device engines keep text on your Mac with no per-token costs; optional cloud providers use your own API key and bill separately. The download and Demo provider are free forever. Every real provider, including on-device engines, requires TextWiz Pro. Requires macOS 15.2 or later.

## Product and setup

- [Overview and FAQ](https://textwiz.pro/index.md): Features, supported engines, TextWiz Pro, privacy, and common questions.
- [Setup and API keys](https://textwiz.pro/getting-started.md): Apple Intelligence, Ollama and Gemini setup, provider key links, and clipboard or Services workflows.
- [Changelog](https://textwiz.pro/changelog.md): Release notes and current GitHub release availability.
